description: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and two metrics: "Perplexity" and "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", alongside their respective full cache baselines. The x-axis represents the "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot features dual y-axes: the left y-axis represents "Perplexity" on a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis represents "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" on a linear scale from 40 to 100 with tick intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed in the plot. The "Perplexity" line is a solid brown line with circular markers, corresponding to the left y-axis; it begins at approximately 4.59 at x=10, declines to 4.30 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, dips to a low of 4.29 at x=70, increases to 4.39 at x=90, and ends at 4.38 at x=100. The "Full Cache PPL" line is a dashed brown line without markers that remains constant at approximately 4.38 across the entire x-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line is a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponding to the right y-axis; it starts at approximately 40 at x=10, exhibits a gradual steady increase to approximately 48 at x=70 and 55 at x=80, then sharply spikes to approximately 98 at x=90, ending at 100 at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." line is a dashed blue line without markers that remains constant at 100 across the entire x-axis.
